title: Student Athlete Onboarding & Baseline Questionnaire
purpose: Screen Demo preview of the uploaded non-IRB questionnaire. Responses are not persisted.

questions.question: I understand the purpose of this onboarding questionnaire and how my responses will be used.
choices: I have a question before continuing
questions.instructions:
Purpose. This questionnaire establishes a starting point for your onboarding and helps the pilot team understand your current well-being, recovery, performance readiness, support awareness, and experience entering the platforms. It is for service delivery and internal pilot evaluation. It is not being presented as an IRB-approved research study and it is not a diagnostic assessment.

Answer based on how you have felt during the past 7 days unless a question says otherwise.

There are no right or wrong answers. Honest responses help the platforms provide a more useful experience.

Your individual mental-health and help-seeking responses will not be provided to coaches, teammates, or performance personnel.

Completing the questionnaire does not replace counseling, medical care, or emergency support.

You may skip any optional question. Questions marked Required are needed to establish your onboarding baseline.

Important safety note. This form is not monitored as an emergency service and does not ask crisis or self-harm questions. If you are in immediate danger or need urgent support, call 911 or 988, or contact the emergency or clinical resource identified by Clark Atlanta University.
